[Story]
In a future city floating in the clouds, there is a robot named Sparkle. This city is called Skyport, floating so high that it never encounters land animals, and Sparkle never understands them. Skyport has various aircraft and drones. Sparkle is performing imitation behavior: it gracefully stretches its arms and then retracts them, replicating the opening and closing actions, similar to the way a butterfly flutters its wings.

[Question]
What does Sparkle possibly imitate?

[Candidate Answers]
A. A bird spreads its wings
B. A butterfly spreads its wings
C. A drone extends and retracts its landing gear
D. A flower blooms and closes
